scope: synthetic quantized-target TP4/EP4-shaped rank-local body only; no TP collectives, model weights or serving claim
core_build: actual production O2 core25f3; no JIT alternative
dispatch_scope: direct production K2 body at each M; intentionally bypasses Python target cap8 to evaluate a possible larger cap

only_changes: hoist constant expert map from per-call graph work
return existing routed top-k IDs for exact selected-set checks

parity_policy: all outputs max_abs<0.005, residual bit identity, exact selected-expert sets; no router-tie mask

launch_count.mode: source expectation only; GPU launch count not profiled
launch_count.warning: Each source stage can lower to multiple/no kernels; allocations are not automatically GPU launches. Constant expert-map initialization excluded from both measured graphs.
